newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez in deal to sell Salins du Midi stake.
newsitem.headline: Suez in deal to sell Salins du Midi stake.

text.p: Cie de Suez said on Tuesday that it had signed a definitive agreement to sell to Morton International Suez Industrie's 50.8 percent stake in Cie des Salins du Midi et des Salines de l'Est.
The price will be 614 francs per share including the 1996 dividend.
Suez said Credit Agricole unit L'Union d'Etudes et d'Investissements and the Rougie family, which hold 10.3 percent and 6.5 percent, respectively, of Cie des Salins joined in the deal.
Suez said Morton planned to make a public offer to take over the rest of Cie des Salins once the deal with Suez was complete.
After the purchase from Suez, Morton will own 67.6 percent of the capital and 66.5 percent of the voting rights of Cie des Salins, Suez said.
Suez said the deal was conditional on approval from the ministry of industry.
Suez said Morton planned to maintain Cie des Salins' French and European identity through its decentralised operations.
